instruction: Implement clamp(value, low, high), including values outside the interval.

files.app.py: def clamp(v, lo, hi): return v

solution.app.py: def clamp(v, lo, hi): return min(hi, max(lo, v))

acceptance: from app import clamp; assert clamp(-3,0,4)==0; assert clamp(7,0,4)==4; assert clamp(2,0,4)==2

instruction: Fix mean so it includes every item and rejects empty input with ValueError.
Fix the invoice total, including the shipping charge stored in rates.py.

files.app.py:
from rates import SHIPPING
def total(items): return sum(items)

solution.app.py:
from rates import SHIPPING
def total(items): return sum(items)+SHIPPING

acceptance: from app import total; assert total([3,7])==15

instruction: Implement slug(text) that lowercases words and joins whitespace with hyphens.
acceptance: from app import slug; assert slug("  Hello   WORLD ")=="hello-world"

def page(xs,n,size): return xs
